title: A Safehouse for the Deadline Revisited
author: Yara Villalobos
blurb: Oscar Lockridge, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
